$description: EDH Seer SHIPS ONE THEME AND REFUSES MORE. This file used to carry four brand themes and three density modes; none of them existed in the product. The refusal is a design decision with a reason, so it is recorded here rather than left as an empty file.

theme.$description: One theme, dark, named for the ground it is built on. `:root`, `.light` and `.default` in index.css all resolve to it and `color-scheme: dark` is set, so there is no light variant to override and no `dark` map in colors.json.

standings-desk.$description: A conventional dark analytics dashboard held to the craft bar of Scryfall and Archidekt/Moxfield. No illustrated conceit, no card-frame cosplay - plain category convention, executed with real polish. Sans throughout.

refused.$description: WHY THERE IS NO SECOND THEME. v1 derived the accent from the deck's colour identity and shipped a picker to pin it. Both were deleted: a user comparing eight decks must see eight identities at once, which a themed interface cannot express - the chrome would claim a colour the content needs. A per-brand or per-deck palette would reintroduce exactly that. Identity belongs in the DATA layer (tokens/data-viz.json mana ramp), never in the chrome.

brand-themes.$value: refused: the accent is a fixed literal, off-hue and outside WUBRG, so it can never be read as mana

light-mode.$value: not shipped: index.css sets color-scheme dark and points .light at the same values

density-modes.$value: not shipped: one spacing scale, Tailwind's 4px base (tokens/spacing.json)
